thread:
maria_devex: Heads-up — discovered two copy/paste issues in the TypeScript quickstart sample. Customer couldn't get the client to initialize and auth failed.

maria_devex: Repro: clone quickstart, npm i, run example -> 401 or "createClient is not a function".

maria_devex: Bad snippet in README:
```ts
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference';

const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hi' });
```

maria_devex: Problems: 1) the package exports `createClient`, not `Redwood`. 2) header example above uses `apiKey` / RW_API_KEY env var but onboarding expects `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and Authorization: Bearer header. Copy/paste from old internal sample.

rahul_sdk: ack, saw this in logs. Old snippet came from v0 -> we changed exports in v1. I'll open a PR to update the README and add a quick unit smoke test.

rahul_sdk: Proposed fix:
```ts
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference';

const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.text.generate({ input: 'hi' });
```

rahul_sdk: And update the curl example to use `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY` instead of `X-Api-Key`.

sam_engineer: Thanks. Can we add a CI check that runs the docs sample (basic compile + smoke call against the mocked http server)? Catches this class of drift.

rahul_sdk: Yep planning to add a tiny GH action that does `npm ci && npm run build && node samples/ts/quickstart.js` with a mocked env var and recorded fixture. Will open in the same PR.

doc-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/348 — updates quickstart TS and curl auth. Includes test action.

maria_devex: Awesome. @katie_pm FYI — this caused a customer onboarding hiccup this morning, tracking in support ticket #7891. Should we surface the fix in the status page or changelog?

katie_pm: Please add a short note to the changelog and ping onboarding slack. We'll include in the weekly release notes. :thumbsup:

sam_engineer: One more thing — update the README snip where we show `client.generate` to match new names (`text.generate`). Might be worth a brief migration note.

rahul_sdk: Will do. Adding a small migration section and mentioning env var name change.

maria_devex: closing loop — QA will smoke the updated doc once PR merges. Thanks all :rocket:
